result: Every dimension-four subspace of sl_3(F_2) contains characteristic polynomial t^3+t. Threshold three is attained by strict upper-triangular matrices.
verification: Self-contained rank-one seven-point counting, quotient evaluation and rank-nullity proof independently checked; de Seguins Pazzis arXiv1105.1872v3 Definition1/Theorem2 fetched and read. A locally developed independent quadratic proof was written before this response was read.
consequence: All connected regular elementary abelian Heawood covers with rank>=4 have beta>=4n/7 and SF-beta<=floor(n/49). No exact higher-cover SF value claimed.
verdict_scope: Research answer, not an acceptance review of the later written notes; no new Lean claim for matrix-space dimension or character/fiber counting.
